title: SOLVINDEN table lamp
description: SOLVINDEN table lamp, battery operated donut-shaped, 43/4" This battery-operated lamp looks like an odd donut and spreads a cozy decorative light. Just as easy to hang from a tree in the garden as to place on a table in your outdoor space or living room. Gives a nice decorative light.
features: Only use batteries that are intended for the product. Do not mix old and new batteries, different brands or types.
Approved for use as outdoor lighting, IP 44.
The light source has a lifetime of approx. 25,000 hours. This corresponds to about 20 years if the lamp is on for 3 hours per day.
Batteries should be handed in for recycling in accordance with local environmental regulations for waste disposal.
Batteries sold separately. recommends LADDA rechargeable battery 2450 mAh HR6 AA 1.2V. 2 pieces required.
Observe the polarity marks plus (+) and minus (−) and ensure correct battery insertion into the product.
The built-in timer is pre-set for the light to stay on for 6 hours. It will then automatically turn off for 18 hours before it turns back on again.
materialAndCare: Body/ Switch cover: ABS plastic; Battery box: Polypropylene; Rope: 100 % polypropylene, Synthetic rubber
